nodes.description: Untrusted caller address; controls token transfers, approvals and ownership acceptance.
Contract owner address set in Owned constructor, enforced by onlyOwner.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
Token symbol string, set to tDOGE.
Token name string, set to TravalaDoge.
Token decimals, set to 18.
Total token supply, 1000000000000000000000000000000000 base units.
Mapping address => token balance.
Nested mapping owner => spender => remaining allowance.
Addition with overflow check require(c >= a).
Subtraction with underflow check require(b <= a).
Multiplication with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division with zero-divisor check require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new pending owner.
Pending owner accepts ownership; requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor; mints the entire supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without double-spend protection.
Moves tokens using the allowance of msg.sender via SafeMath.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls the spender's receiveApproval callback.
Payable fallback function that always reverts.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token address.
External call to untrusted spender contract via receiveApproval inside approveAndCall.
External call to attacker-supplied tokenAddress in transferAnyERC20Token.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner during the Owned constructor, granting full privileges.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete ownership transfer.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled key.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner before invoking the callback.
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument of the untrusted receiveApproval external call.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the privileged caller.
Parameter 'to' is consumed by TravalaDoge.transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' is consumed by TravalaDoge.transfer.
Parameter 'spender' is consumed by TravalaDoge.approve.
Parameter 'tokens' is consumed by TravalaDoge.approve.
Parameter 'from' is consumed by TravalaDoge.transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' is consumed by TravalaDoge.transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens' is consumed by TravalaDoge.transferFrom.
Parameter 'spender' selects the callee of the receiveApproval callback.
Parameter 'tokens' becomes the spender allowance in approveAndCall.
Parameter 'data' is forwarded verbatim into the external callback.
Parameter '_newOwner' is consumed by transferOwnership.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' becomes the external call target.
Parameter 'tokens' is forwarded to the arbitrary ERC20 contract.
transfer updates both the sender and recipient entries of balances.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom updates the from and to entries of balances.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in allowed.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply as the left operand of an unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply performs the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
The subtraction operand balances[address(0)] can be inflated by transfers to the zero address, enabling underflow.
Constructor assigns the whole supply to a fixed address in balances.
Constructor sets _totalSupply.
Constructor sets symbol.
Constructor sets name.
Constructor sets decimals.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes the missing-trust receiveApproval external call on the spender.
The untrusted spender contract controls execution during receiveApproval and can re-enter the token.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary tokenAddress.
The arbitrary token contract can call back into TravalaDoge during the forwarded transfer.
transferOwnership writes the privileged newOwner slot.
acceptOwnership moves ownership by writing owner = newOwner.
safeAdd stores the overflow-checked result in local c.
safeSub stores the underflow-checked result in local c.
safeMul stores the overflow-checked product in local c.
safeDiv stores the checked quotient in local c.
